svg.title: Figure 1 - GARQ final revised workflow
svg.desc: Editable vector workflow. Panel f illustrates downstream MOFA+ integration, outside GARQ. Two shared cell states remain distinct before and after integration; batch-specific offsets within each state are reduced and batch colors intermix. All 18 schematic metacell identities and their state and batch membership are preserved. This is an explanatory schematic, not measured integration results. The matrices also contain illustrative values.

g.text: Preprocess each modality independently; concatenate only after encoding (b).
n: cells in current mini-batch; α = 0.2
Anchor identities and total K are preserved.
